projection: orthographic top; RGBA cells; no lighting baked in colour
normalConvention: object/world XYZ encoded in RGB; not tangent-space normals
notes: Original model surface study. Living colour is artistic; skeletal morphology and soft coating must remain separate. Transparent exterior is a mask.
heightEncoding: 8-bit RGBA orthographic reference only; not a 16-bit displacement map
dataSampling: One point sample per pixel; denoising/compositor/sequencer disabled; 0.01 px box filter; Raw linear output; no RGB dilation or normal reconstruction across transparent exterior. Alpha is coverage, not a normal component.
